description: Llevamos el conocimiento espacial a todos, sin importar su edad o nivel técnico
summary:
SKYO is a technology platform developed with the mission of bringing the universe closer to everyone, transforming the way we explore and understand space. Our project aims to simplify access to and visualization of astronomical data and images from NASA’s SPHEREx mission through an interactive, intuitive, and accessible experience.
We recognize that, although missions like SPHEREx generate scientific information of immense value for understanding the universe, accessing and interpreting it can be a challenge for those without specialized technical knowledge. To address this challenge, we developed SKYO, a platform that transforms that complexity into a simple experience, allowing anyone to explore and discover the cosmos in a more intimate, visual, and understandable way.
Our solution aims to break down technological barriers and bring space exploration closer to students, enthusiasts, researchers, and the general public. We believe that knowledge of the universe shouldn’t be limited to experts: with SKYO, we want everyone to have the opportunity to explore the sky and discover the extraordinary things that exist beyond our planet.
details:
SKYO is an interactive digital platform designed to make space exploration accessible to everyone by simplifying access to and visualization of astronomical information from NASA’s SPHEREx mission.

The platform allows users to explore astronomical information and images through an intuitive and accessible interface. Its goal is to transform scientific data—which can be complex—into a visual and understandable experience, without requiring specialized knowledge of astronomy or programming.

We aspire to serve as a bridge between space research and the curiosity of millions of people.

To develop SKYO, we use various technologies and programming tools.

- JavaScript, CSS, HTML, Python, shell, Rust, batchfile

We also used AI-assisted development tools such as OpenCode, Codex, Antigravity, and ChatGPT, which helped us during the process of programming, troubleshooting, optimization, and building the platform.

Our creativity lies in rethinking the way people interact with astronomical information. Instead of requiring users to understand complex scientific systems, we strive to make technology adapt to people.
